name: War-Rune Mastery
summary: Once per short rest, when you cast a Minor or Standard power from the Warlock, Divination, or Telekinesis lists, you may target one additional creature within 10 ft of the original target. The second target takes half damage; if the power has no damage, the secondary effect lasts no longer than until the start of your next turn unless the GM rules the effect cannot sensibly be split.
